method.name: Integrated ownership
method.description: How much of the company each party holds, directly and through the companies it holds: shares are multiplied along each path and added across paths, and a company's own shares are given back to its other holders. Each source is computed on its own; figures from two sources are listed side by side, never added. Shareholdings only — voting rights, roles and control are not shares. For a person it is arithmetic on what was filed, not a determination of beneficial ownership. Context, not a finding.
method.credit: Method: integrated ownership as published by T-Rank (https://docs.trank.no/white_papers).

response.note: Calculated figures are arithmetic on what the sources filed — shares multiplied along each path and added across paths, one figure per source, never added across sources — not a determination that anyone is a beneficial owner. Declared beneficial owners are as each register publishes them.

sanctions_ownership_test.summary: Designated parties' stated shareholdings meet the sanctions ownership test for OFAC (US), EU and UK. OFAC (US), EU and UK: meets — more than 50% up to 75% held by designated parties (UK Companies House). Computed by OpenCheck from stated shareholdings, one source at a time; ownership only — the EU and UK control tests are not computed — and not a determination that the company is sanctioned or blocked.

regimes.rule: 50% or more, held by blocked persons together (OFAC's 50 Percent Rule)
50% or more of the proprietary rights, held by designated persons together

sanctions_ownership_test.method: Computed by OpenCheck from the shareholdings the sources state, one source at a time: the holdings of parties designated under each regime are added (OFAC, EU) or taken one designated party at a time (UK); a company they hold enough of counts as caught, and its own holdings then count in full. The lowest reading of every stake decides whether the test is met; the highest decides whether it may be. Only parties matched on an identifier or with corroboration are counted. Ownership only: the EU and UK control tests are not computed. Arithmetic on the records, not a determination that the company is sanctioned, blocked or frozen.
sanctions_ownership_test.not_computed: Not computed: control — the EU and UK also treat a company as caught when a designated person controls it (appoints its board, directs it, or by agreement); OFAC licences and general licences; holdings that have ended — OFAC treats property blocked while the test was met as still blocked after the blocked persons themselves reduce their stake (FAQ 402), and OpenCheck reads current holdings only; programmes that block on ownership or control by a government without a 50% test (Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Venezuela and Crimea, FAQ 398); and OFAC's Sectoral Sanctions Identifications list, which is outside this test.
sanctions_ownership_test.credit: Method: the 50% rule as published by T-Rank (https://docs.trank.no/white_papers).
